newsitem.title: USA: Metallurg had Q1 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Metallurg had Q1 operating profit.

text.p: Metallurg Inc said Monday it had first quarter, ended March 31, operating income of about $6.5 million.

"We believe that our first reported operating results for the four months ending July 31, 1997, will reflect our continuing progress both operationally and financially," the company's prepared statement continued. "Indeed, industry conditions are currently strong and we believe the outlook for both the company and our industries is bright."
